{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{c_label}Passive:{/c} While equipped on the knight, {c_important}Hell Standard{/c} grants you and allies around you {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|%|]{/c} resource per second.

{c_label}Active:{/c} {c_important}Hell Standard{/c} consecrates the ground, making all enemies inside vulnerable and unable to leave the seal while granting all allies inside {c_number}[{SF_8} * 100|%|]{/c} attack speed and damage for {c_number}[{SF_3}|1|]{/c} seconds.
